entities.summary: Phillip Francis Straling is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of San Bernardino in California from 1978 to 1995, and as Bishopbishop]] of the Diocese of Reno in Nevada from 1995 to 2005.
